task.population: The phlebotomy-weighted complete-measurement domain of nonpregnant women aged 20–44 in NHANES August 2021–August 2023; RIDEXPRG=2, both measured hemoglobin and raw ferritin, positive phlebotomy weight. Pregnancy unknown/incomplete excluded; no CRP restriction. Equal-weight virtual rows represent this domain only under explicit transport assumptions. No individual measurements or target outcome summaries are supplied.

excluded_cohorts: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey

model.family: Gaussian copula with bounded continuous Hb and piecewise truncated-lognormal ferritin marginals

transport.threshold_probabilities: Use the source paired-cell proportions as target-domain population probabilities, without covariate adjustment.
transport.ferritin_geometric_mean: Use the reported source geometric mean, 17.4 ug/L, as the target-domain population geometric mean.
transport.weighting: Generate independent equal-weight people from this assumed target law; do not simulate source sampling weights.

hb.distribution: Normal(location, scale) truncated to the stated bounds
hb.location_rule: Solve P(Hb < 12) = 258/1671 under the truncated normal.

ferritin.distribution: A mixture at 15 ug/L, with normally distributed log concentrations centered at log(15) and separately truncated below and above log(15)
ferritin.upper_log_scale_rule: Solve E[log(ferritin)] = log(17.4), holding the lower-component probability and lower log scale fixed.

dependence.interpretation: The fitted latent correlation is neither a reported Pearson correlation nor a reported Spearman correlation.

numerics.probability_endpoint_guard: Clip normal-CDF probabilities only to the nearest representable floating-point numbers strictly inside (0,1).
